name: Native Postman alternative for iOS and Mac

mentions.name: Native Postman alternative for iOS and Mac
mentions.description: A lightweight native API testing app for iOS and Mac built as an alternative to Postman. It reaches Postman feature parity at around 4MB, adds iCloud sync, and supports MCP so test suites can be controlled from Claude on Mac. It includes no-code style assertions and is being made available to others via TestFlight.
mentions.problem: Postman is a resource hog, and many people are feeling done with it
mentions.audience: People who are feeling done with Postman
mentions.source_excerpt: Got tired of postman being such a resource hog, so I made a native app that does much same thing for iOS and Mac.
mentions.author: anurodhp
